## Hot-file serial queue

## Notes

- **Landing on this board.** `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `docs/adr/**` are objectui's governed surfaces: a PR touching any stays draft until an APPROVED review by `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` (`os-zhuang` / `hotlong`); then the seat lands it (ready + auto-merge → the merge queue; a direct merge is refused 405). The dev-side governed pre-check is `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test PATHS` in this repo. Two of the three waiting PRs share `schema-expressions.md`: `update-branch` before readying the second.
- **Changesets.** A docs-only PR carries an EMPTY-frontmatter changeset; the `skip-changeset` label object exists on this board but is a phantom wired to nothing — ⛔ never apply it.
- **Comments.** objectui's `AGENTS.md` bans model identifiers in comments. The claim recogniser accepts the model-free ceiling spelling `model: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` with `MANDATORY` cited on the same line; every claim on this board uses it (objectstack PR #21269 taught the template the same).
- **Gates for `skills/**` edits**: `check:skills-paths`, `check:skill-examples` (needs a `--build-filter` scoped build under objectstack's `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, ~3–4 min), `check:skill-eval-tokens` (an eval-token oracle, not a size meter — objectui has no skills line/token ratchet; the seat budgets LINES per card), `check:new-line-citations` (differential; cite by content, never a path with a line number), `lint.yml`'s roster (its decide step excludes `**/*.md` and `.changeset/**`, so a docs-only PR reports with steps skipped).
- **Platform readings this shift:** container Node v22.22.0 is below jsdom@30's `^22.22.2` floor under this repo's `engine-strict` — every dev installed with `pnpm install --config.engine-strict=false` (recorded as a deviation each time); the write budget (40 / trailing hour) is shared with objectstack's seat and devs — see objectstack-ai/objectstack#7623 Notes ①.
- **Deploy registration.** A merge to `main` publishes nothing by itself (publishing runs only through `changeset-release.yml`'s explicit publish lane); the published skills catalog ships by `npx skills add`, so a wrong `skills/**` line is installed elsewhere before anyone here reads it.
- **Checkout**: `/home/user/objectui` at `990a2d61` (= `origin/main` at this refresh).
